zh-CN: 这个示例将 Python 游戏逻辑与 JavaScript Canvas 界面放进同一个原生桌面窗口。回合规则、战斗和存档由 Python 处理，前端负责地牢画面与交互展示，展示 Web 技术如何成为 Python 游戏的界面层。
观看真实录制了解提灯探索、移动与战斗，或放大截图查看像素地牢和角色状态。源码、运行步骤与发行版本由独立 Emberkeep 仓库维护。
en: This example brings Python game logic and a JavaScript Canvas interface into one native desktop window. Python handles turns, combat, and saves, while the frontend renders the dungeon and its interactions: a practical example of using web technology as a Python game UI.

Watch the native recording for lantern-lit exploration, movement, and combat, or open the screenshot to inspect the dungeon and character stats. The independent Emberkeep repository maintains source code, run instructions, and releases.

zh-CN: 打开 MusicXML、XML 或受限的 MXL 乐谱，以 Canvas 2D 下落音符或按需排版的五线谱查看曲目。Python 准备播放数据，随包 SoundFont 提供钢琴声音，播放与高亮跟随设备 DAC 时钟。
练习时可使用 0.5×、0.75× 或原速播放，并设置 A/B 循环片段。支持导出 A4 PDF、原文件副本和 Type 1 MIDI；MIDI 目前仅用于导出，不接受 MIDI 输入。当前验证平台为 macOS ARM64，应用不提供演奏输入或评分。
en: Open MusicXML, XML, or supported MXL scores and follow Canvas 2D falling notes or sheet music laid out on demand. Python prepares playback data; a bundled SoundFont supplies piano audio, with playback and highlighting following the device DAC clock.

Practice at 0.5×, 0.75×, or the original speed and set A/B loop sections. Export A4 PDF, an original-file copy, or Type 1 MIDI. MIDI is export-only. The currently verified platform is macOS ARM64; performance input and scoring are not provided.

zh-CN: 六类可编辑案例覆盖同步函数、asyncio Promise、实例、list 代理、异常和实时 dict。在 AppCore 原生窗口中修改两端代码并运行，查看真实结果、控制台日志和对象状态，无需 Node.js 或 Web 服务。
共享容器展示 Python list/dict 与 JavaScript Array/Object 的双向访问及引用身份。代码直接在当前桌面进程执行；安装依赖后可离线运行。运行指南还提供 CPU 渲染与原生冒烟检查方式。
en: Six editable examples cover synchronous functions, asyncio promises, instances, list proxies, exceptions, and live dictionaries. Edit both sides in an AppCore native window and inspect real results, console logs, and object state without Node.js or a web server.

Shared containers demonstrate two-way access between Python list/dict and JavaScript Array/Object while retaining reference identity. Code runs in the current desktop process. After dependency installation, the app works offline; the run guide also covers CPU rendering and native smoke checks.

description.zh-CN: Bridge Lab 是 ultralight-py 的 Python 与 JavaScript 双向桥接实验室。在原生桌面窗口中编辑并运行六个案例，探索同步函数、asyncio 与 Promise、对象及 list/dict 共享代理和异常处理。
description.en: Bridge Lab explores Python–JavaScript interop with ultralight-py. Edit and run six examples in a native desktop window, covering functions, asyncio promises, shared object and list/dict proxies, and errors.

zh-CN: 使用 Vue 2、DOM 与 TypeScript 网格背包界面，完成拖动物品、R 键旋转、装备与卸装、堆叠合并及拆分、宝石镶嵌和快捷栏绑定。界面通过 ultralight-py 宿主桥接向 Python 提交预览与操作命令。
Python 后端持有物品身份、容器、装备和快捷栏的权威状态，事务提交后发送事件，Vue 再获取展示副本。默认使用内存存储，启动时传入 --state 路径可启用文件持久化；前端需先构建，再在原生桌面窗口中运行。
en: Use a Vue 2, DOM, and TypeScript grid inventory interface to drag and rotate items, equip gear, merge or split stacks, socket gems, and bind a quickbar. The UI sends preview and action commands to Python through the ultralight-py host bridge.

Python owns item identity, containers, equipment, and quickbar state. Committed transactions emit events so Vue can fetch detached display snapshots. Storage is in-memory by default; pass a --state path to enable file persistence. Build the frontend before running it in a native desktop window.
